title: Us vs. Them — line-level provenance for human vs AI edits
excerpt: A review and listing of the Us vs. Them developer tool on AgentDish, describing it as a CLI/library for line-level provenance in text edited by humans and agents, using version history to estimate which ranges are human-written versus machine-generated. The page notes the tool's score is 78, with strengths in clear presentation and weaknesses around undocumented algorithm limits and packaging.
